'''Tower Defense Simulator Award Nominations''' ---- Every year, Roblox hosts the Innovation Awards event (formerly the Bloxys). Tower Defense Simulator has been nominated by Roblox in the Bloxys and Innovation Awards five times, all in different categories, winning only one of them.
__TOC__ ==Roblox Innovation Awards 2026 (Nominated)== In the [[w:c:Roblox:Roblox Innovation Awards 2026|Roblox Innovation Awards 2026]], Tower Defense Simulator was nominated for ''Best Strategy Experience''. The reward was originally listed by BelowNatural as a Bloxy skin of community's choice, though it was quickly changed to just a special celebration. A KJ [[Brawler]] skin was also shown off by a developer at one point, though its lack of acknowledgement points towards it being a joke and not an actual reward. ===Nominees=== {| class="article-table pad-5 align-center" style="width:350px;" !Game !Result |- |{{RLinkG|131346454575416|Mini War}} | class="yes-table" |Won |- |{{RLinkG|9503261072|Tower Defense X}} | class="no-table" |Nominated |- |{{RLinkG|3260590327|Tower Defense Simulator}} | class="no-table" |Nominated |- |{{RLinkG|2569453732|Rise of Nations}} | class="no-table" |Nominated |} ===Gallery=== {{Gallery|Open = Yes| InnovationAwards2026Icon.png|Icon for the Innovation Awards. InnovationAwards2026.png|Promotional image for the Innovation Awards. InnovationAwards2026Message.png|Message asking the player to vote for Tower Defense Simulator added in [[v2.3.0|v2.3.4]]. InnovationAwards2026MessageFixed.png|Message asking the player to vote for Tower Defense Simulator after a minor correction in [[v2.3.0|v2.3.5]]. Free KJ Brawler - Tower Defense Simulator|Video posted by a developer on X. Lack of acknowledgement past this point suggest this was just a joke.https://x.com/Vylithh/status/2074282329300779429 }} ==Roblox Innovation Awards 2024 (Nominated)== In the [[w:c:Roblox:Roblox Innovation Awards 2024|Roblox Innovation Awards 2024]], Tower Defense Simulator was nominated for ''Best Strategy Game''. If Tower Defense Simulator had won the category, a special skin themed around the Event would have been made, similar to the {{Color|Other|Bloxy}} [[Commander]]. ===Nominees=== {| class="article-table pad-5 align-center" style="width:350px;" !Game !Result |- |{{RLinkG|17017769292|Anime Defenders}} | class="no-table" |4th Place |- |{{RLinkG|16389395869|a dusty trip}} | class="no-table" |3rd Place |- |{{RLinkG|3260590327|Tower Defense Simulator}} | class="no-table" |2nd Place |- |{{RLinkG|10449761463|The Strongest Battlegrounds}} | class="yes-table" |1st Place |} ===Gallery=== {{Gallery|Open = Yes| TDSInnovationAwardsThumbnail.png|Thumbnail for the Innovation Awards. }} ==Roblox Innovation Awards 2022 (Nominated)== In the [[w:c:Roblox:Roblox Innovation Awards 2022|Roblox Innovation Awards 2022]], Tower Defense Simulator was nominated for ''Best Content Update'', specifically the [[v1.0.0|Solar Eclipse Update]]. If Tower Defense Simulator had won the category, a bigger gift than the {{Color|Other|Bloxy}} [[Commander]] skin would have been made, alongside [[The Umbra]] returning. ===Nominees=== {| class="article-table pad-5 align-center" style="width:350px;" !Game !Result |- |{{RLinkG|4623386862|Piggy}} | class="yes-table" |Won |- |{{RLinkG|3260590327|Tower Defense Simulator}} | class="no-table" |Nominated |- |{{RLinkG|606849621|Jailbreak}} | class="no-table" |Nominated |- |{{RLinkG|306964494|Loomian Legacy}} | class="no-table" |Nominated |} ===Gallery=== {{Gallery|Open = Yes| Bloxy2022PI.jpg|Promotional image for the Innovation Awards. VOTE for the UMBRA at the Roblox Innovation Awards NOW! - Tower Defense Simulator|Promotional video for the Innovation Awards. BloxyLobby.png|Lobby during the Innovation Awards. }} ==8th Annual Bloxy Awards (Won)== In the [[w:c:Roblox:8th Annual Bloxy Awards|8th Annual Bloxy Awards]], Tower Defense Simulator was nominated for ''Best Game Trailer'', specifically for the [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Lzpw58W-BYs 2020 Tower Defense Simulator Trailer]. As Tower Defense Simulator won the category, the {{Color|Other|Bloxy}} [[Commander]] skin was added to the game, obtained through the now expired BLOXY21 code.
